split: v1 failed preserved; development consists of development.json and opened holdout.json; new holdout-v2 is evaluated once after revision freeze
matching: exact kind+quote multiset; repeated identical mentions counted separately; case and whitespace exact
unmet_policy: report FAIL and leave BE05 unaccepted; do not average failures away
scope: synthetic extractive mentions only; not clinical truth or normalized interpretations
annotation_protocol: symptom: minimal symptom phrase without intensity or negation; negation: single marker отрицает/отрицаю/нет/не; duration: omit approximators уже/около/примерно but retain в течение; uncertainty: explicit probability word; preserve case, prepositions and inflection; medication: full contiguous actual intake phrase excluding subject/time/uncertainty; time: include preposition, omit punctuation
